messages.en:
Check out the snow,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!

Snow looks like powdered
sugar, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! I like
to roll around in it!
messages.et:
Lumi näeb välja nagu
tuhksuhkur, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! Mulle
meeldib selles püherdada!

messages.en:
The {ff 00 00 03}Bright Nights{ff 00 00 00} have
started, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!

{07 14 00}Hey,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} the {ff 00 00 03}Bright
Nights{ff 00 00 00} finally start today,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}Who do you think will win{01 00 00 0a 00}
this year's decoration
contest?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} {ff 00 00 03}valgus-
ööd{ff 00 00 00} algavad lõpuks täna,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}Kes sinu arust võidab{01 00 00 0a 00}
selle aasta
kaunistusvõistluse?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} What do
you think of my house?

{07 19 00}Getting that pathetically
dim glow{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 16 00} took a lot of
work,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Mida sa
arvad minu majast?

{07 19 00}Selle haledalt tuhmi
sära saamine{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 16 00} võttis palju
tööd,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Doesn't
my house look all sparkly?

{07 0d 00}Come on! Tell me how great
it looks!{01 00 00 14 00} I thrive on
compliments!
{07 00 00}Oh,{01 00 00 05 00} and if you see the
{ff 00 00 06}mayor {ff 00 00 00}today, tell him how
much you like my house, 'k?
{07 14 00}{07 0b 00}Do you think he'll
compliment my house?{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 01 00}'Cause he really SHOULD!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Kas mu
maja ei sätenda?

{07 0d 00}Ole nüüd! Ütle, kui
suurepärane see on!{01 00 00 14 00} Ma elan
komplimentidest!
{07 00 00}Oh,{01 00 00 05 00} ja kui näed täna
{ff 00 00 06}linnapead{ff 00 00 00}, ütle talle, kui
väga sulle mu maja meeldib.
{07 14 00}{07 0b 00}Kas arvad, et ta teeb
mu majale komplimendi?{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 01 00}Sest ta tõesti PEAKS!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Huh huh huh!{01 00 00 0a 00} My house is all
aglow, {01 00 00 03 00}like a starry night
sky! {01 00 00 0a 00}Isn't it pretty?
{07 11 00}I can't wait to gloat about
your reaction to
{ff 00 00 06}{04 0c 00}{ff 00 00 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hah hah haa!{01 00 00 0a 00} Mu maja
helendab {01 00 00 03 00}nagu tähetaevas!
{01 00 00 0a 00}Kas pole ilus?
{07 11 00}Ootan juba, millal saan
{ff 00 00 06}{04 0c 00}{ff 00 00 00}-le sinu
reaktsiooniga kiidelda!

messages.en:
{07 0a 00}Wow,{01 00 00 03 00} {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} I{01 00 00 03 00}-I won!{01 01 00}
I'm the king of cool! {01 00 00 05 00}The
duke of decorating!{01 00 00 05 00} The--
Well, you get my point.{01 01 00}
{07 08 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I worked so hard for this
very moment!
{07 14 00}I'd like to thank
{ff 00 00 06}{04 0b 00}{ff 00 00 00} and you for all
your support!
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}Vau,{01 00 00 03 00} {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} Ma{01 00 00 03 00}-võitsin!{01 01 00}
Olen lahe kuningas! {01 00 00 05 00}Ehte-
hertsog!{01 00 00 05 00} Kõige--
Noh, sa said aru.{01 01 00}
{07 08 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Ma töötasin nii kõvasti
selle hetke nimel!
{07 14 00}Tahan tänada
{ff 00 00 06}{04 0b 00}{ff 00 00 00}-t ja sind kogu
toetuse eest!

messages.en:
{07 0d 00}Huh huh huh{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} I guess my
house did look pretty good,
didn't it!
{07 17 00}It should have!{01 00 00 0a 00} I nearly
fried my toenails off
putting up those lights!
messages.et:
{07 0d 00}Hah hah haa{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Vist nägi mu
maja päris hea välja,
kas pole!
{07 17 00}Nii pidigi!{01 00 00 0a 00} Ma peaaegu
praadisin varbaküüned ära
neid tulesid üles pannes!

messages.en:
{07 0a 00}Yayyyy, {04 1f 00}! I LOVE
you,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!

{07 14 00}You put in a good word for
my house, didn't you!{01 01 00} {07 0d 00}I'm SO
happy now, I could explode!
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}Jeee, {04 1f 00}! Ma ARMASTAN
sind,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!

{07 14 00}Sa panid mu maja eest hea
sõna sisse, eks!{01 01 00} {07 0d 00}Olen NII
õnnelik, et plahvatan!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} Thanks
for the kind words about
my sparkly lights!
{07 19 00}Even if {ff 00 00 06}{04 0c 00}{ff 00 00 00} wants
to sneer at my work{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}. Or
call me a hack{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
{07 0a 00}I'm glad YOU appreciate
what I've done, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} Aitäh
lahkete sõnade eest mu
sätendavate tulede kohta!
{07 19 00}Isegi kui {ff 00 00 06}{04 0c 00}{ff 00 00 00} tahab
mu tööd pilgata{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}. Või
nimetada mind sopaks{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
{07 0a 00}Mul on hea meel, et SINA
mu tööd hindad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Have you
seen the lights at
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}'s place?
{07 0e 00}I guess some people always
have to be the center of
attention.
But me,{01 00 00 03 00} I know that {07 06 00}my
place is good, too.{01 00 00 05 00} Uh, isn't
it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Kas oled
näinud tulesid
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} juures?
{07 0e 00}Vist peavad mõned inimesed
alati tähelepanu keskmes
olema.
Aga mina,{01 00 00 03 00} ma tean, et {07 06 00}minu
koht on hea.{01 00 00 05 00} Ee, kas pole,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Check it out, {04 1f 00}.
{01 01 00}{07 15 00}You like the decorations
that {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} has up?
{07 1b 00}Well, I guess there's no
accounting for taste. {01 00 00 0a 00}
Especially bad taste!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Vaata seda, {04 1f 00}.
{01 01 00}{07 15 00}Sulle meeldivad kaunistused,
mis {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} üles pani?
{07 1b 00}Noh, maitse üle vist
ei vaielda. {01 00 00 0a 00}
Eriti halva maitse üle!

messages.en:
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} is really
something, huh?

{07 1b 00}Buzzing all over the place,{01 00 00 05 00}
putting up decorations like
it's going out of style{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
You'd never know it from
looking,{01 00 00 03 00} but some people
just get the holiday fever!
messages.et:
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} on küll
midagi, mis?

{07 1b 00}Sibab igal pool ringi,{01 00 00 05 00}
paneb kaunistusi üles nagu
viimset korda{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
Välimuse järgi ei ütleks,{01 00 00 03 00}
aga mõnel lööb
pühadepalavik välja!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}What a bummer that I have
to take down the lights
after the {ff 00 00 03}Bright Nights{ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
{07 00 00}I could live in a lit-up
house all year round,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Milline pettumus, et pean
tuled maha võtma pärast
{ff 00 00 03}valgusöid{ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
{07 00 00}Ma võiksin elada valgustatud
majas aasta läbi,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
So whose place do you think
is {07 0b 00}the absolute best?{01 01 00} {07 00 00}I bet
it's {ff 00 00 06}{04 0d 00}{ff 00 00 00}'s, huh?
messages.et:
Kelle koht on sinu arust
{07 0b 00}kõige parem?{01 01 00} {07 00 00}Vean kihla,
et {ff 00 00 06}{04 0d 00}{ff 00 00 00} oma, mis?
